questions.text: I _____ studying for two hours before the test.
questions.explanation: For an action ongoing until another point in the past, use the Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing).
questions.explanationAr: للتعبير عن حدث كان مستمراً حتى نقطة أخرى في الماضي، نستخدم الماضي التام المستمر (had been + V-ing).

questions.text: She _____ watering the plants before it started to rain.
questions.explanation: The action (watering) was ongoing until another past action (started to rain), so we use 'had been'.
questions.explanationAr: كان الحدث (الري) مستمراً حتى حدوث فعل آخر في الماضي (بدأ المطر)، لذا نستخدم 'had been'.

questions.text: They _____ waiting at the station for an hour before the train arrived.
questions.explanation: The action was ongoing in the past up to a specific point (before the train arrived), so we use Past Perfect Continuous.
questions.explanationAr: كان الحدث مستمراً في الماضي حتى نقطة معينة (قبل وصول القطار)، لذا نستخدم الماضي التام المستمر.

questions.text: He had been playing football _____ an hour before it started to rain.
questions.explanation: 'an hour' is a period of time, so we use 'for'.
questions.explanationAr: 'an hour' (ساعة) هي فترة زمنية، لذا نستخدم 'for'.

questions.text: We had been waiting for the bus _____ morning.
questions.explanation: 'morning' is a starting point in the past, so we use 'since'.
questions.explanationAr: 'morning' (الصباح) هي نقطة بداية في الماضي، لذا نستخدم 'since'.

questions.text: She had been working here for five years _____ she left.
questions.explanation: 'before' indicates that the first action happened earlier than another past action (she left).
questions.explanationAr: 'before' تشير إلى أن الحدث الأول وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (غادرت).

questions.text: I _____ been working all day before the meeting.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'had not' (hadn't) + been + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'had not' (hadn't) + been + V-ing.

questions.text: She _____ been studying English before she moved to Canada.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'had not' (hadn't) + been + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'had not' (hadn't) + been + V-ing.

questions.text: _____ you been waiting long before I arrived?
questions.explanation: Questions start with 'Had' + Subject + been + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: تبدأ الأسئلة بـ 'Had' + الفاعل + been + V-ing.

questions.text: _____ he been studying for the test before he felt sick?
questions.explanation: Questions start with 'Had' + Subject + been + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: تبدأ الأسئلة بـ 'Had' + الفاعل + been + V-ing.

questions.text: Had you been working? Yes, I _____.
questions.explanation: The short affirmative answer is 'Yes, I had'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة المثبتة هي 'Yes, I had'.

questions.text: Had he been waiting? No, he _____.
questions.explanation: The short negative answer is 'No, he hadn't'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة المنفية هي 'No, he hadn't'.

questions.text: The Past Perfect Continuous shows _____ long an action had been happening.
questions.explanation: This tense emphasizes the duration (how long) of an action.
questions.explanationAr: يؤكد هذا الزمن على مدة (how long) استمرار الحدث.

questions.text: What is the structure of the Past Perfect Continuous?
questions.explanation: The structure uses 'had', 'been', and a verb ending in -ing.
questions.explanationAr: يستخدم التركيب 'had' و 'been' وفعل ينتهي بـ -ing.

questions.text: He had been _____ all day.
questions.explanation: We must use the V-ing form after 'had been'.
questions.explanationAr: يجب أن نستخدم صيغة الفعل المنتهي بـ -ing بعد 'had been'.

questions.text: They had been waiting _____ long when the bus arrived.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'They hadn't been waiting...'.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'They hadn't been waiting...'.

questions.text: Which word is NOT a typical signal word for the Past Perfect Continuous?
questions.explanation: 'tomorrow' is a future signal word, not past.
questions.explanationAr: 'tomorrow' (غدًا) هي كلمة دالة على المستقبل، وليس الماضي.

questions.text: She had been living in Paris _____ 2018.
questions.explanation: 2018 is a starting point, so we use 'since'.
questions.explanationAr: 2018 هي نقطة بداية، لذا نستخدم 'since'.

questions.text: They had been practicing _____ the competition began.
questions.explanation: The practice happened 'before' the competition began.
questions.explanationAr: حدث التدريب 'قبل' (before) أن تبدأ المنافسة.

questions.text: We had been reading _____ two hours.
questions.explanation: 'two hours' is a period of time, so we use 'for'.
questions.explanationAr: 'two hours' (ساعتان) هي فترة زمنية، لذا نستخدم 'for'.

questions.text: 'He had been work all day.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must use the V-ing form: 'He had been working all day.'
questions.explanationAr: إنها خاطئة. يجب استخدام صيغة الفعل بـ -ing: 'He had been working all day.'

questions.text: 'I had been studying since two hours.' is correct.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. 'two hours' is a period of time, so use 'for': 'I had been studying for two hours.'
questions.explanationAr: إنها خاطئة. 'two hours' هي فترة زمنية، لذا استخدم 'for': 'I had been studying for two hours.'

questions.text: 'Did you had been waiting long?' is a correct question.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. The question format is 'Had you been waiting long?'
questions.explanationAr: إنها خاطئة. صيغة السؤال هي 'Had you been waiting long?'

questions.text: 'She hasn't been working since 5 years (before she left).' is correct.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. It mixes tenses and uses 'since' for a period. It should be: 'She hadn't been working for 5 years (before she left).'
questions.explanationAr: إنها خاطئة. فهي تخلط بين الأزمنة وتستخدم 'since' مع فترة. يجب أن تكون: 'She hadn't been working for 5 years (before she left).'

questions.text: 'They had been waiting at the station for an hour before the train arrived.' is correct.
questions.explanation: It is correct. It properly uses 'had been waiting' and 'for' with a time period.
questions.explanationAr: إنها صحيحة. فهي تستخدم 'had been waiting' بشكل صحيح و 'for' مع فترة زمنية.
